items.text: `cleanDoubleSlashes(input, respectQueryAndFragment?)` takes an opt-in second argument `respectQueryAndFragment` (same name as on the trailing-slash helpers). With `true`, only the part before the first `?` or `#` is cleaned, so `/foo//bar?redirect=//baz` becomes `/foo/bar?redirect=//baz`. Default behaviour is unchanged and still collapses `//` in query and fragment. Decided 2026-11-03 because collapsing `//` in the query or fragment broke redirect targets such as `?redirect=//baz`. Implementation: the old logic moved into a private helper `_cleanDoubleSlashes` shared by both paths, with `://` protocol handling preserved; tests added in `test/double-slash.test.ts` and JSDoc/README updated. As of 2026-11-03 the change was uncommitted on branch `fix/double-slashes`, and only the new tests, lint and type-check had been run, not the full suite.

items.text: ufo reached 1.0.0 on 2022-11-14 after a repository refactor, preceded by the feat 'remove undefined from withQuery' (#71) and the fix 'remove leading slash when parsing windows file urls' (#87). Follow-up 1.0.1 (2022-11-29) fixed QueryValue typing (#101), hasProtocol with Windows drive letters (#106) and empty array query values (#103).

Fragment handling utilities: `withFragment` (#193) uses `encodeHash` and returns early when no hash change is needed; `withoutFragment` (#199) is decoupled from `withFragment`. Trailing slash utils were earlier fixed to respect fragments (#175).
